specs.title: the creator changes Issues and an AI Persona in the scenario editor

steps.title: Open your scenario editor; the current Issue and AI Persona are editable.
Add Delivery date, remove Monthly rent, edit the AI Persona, and Save; “Saved.” appears.
Reload the editor; Delivery date remains, Monthly rent is gone, and the edited Persona remains.
Invalid numbers prevent saving; correcting them restores Save.
An empty Persona name shows an error, not Saved; correcting it succeeds.
